brief: Tapered rectangular tower with recessed glazed corners, alternating-floor curtain-wall slopes, 600 mm external glass fins, service louvre belts, diamond-pattern lobby fins, tall cross-braced crown, rooftop helipad, east hotel and west office canopies and curved glass vestibules.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: +X toward north with the cached signed frame
nativeAxes.origin: Tower footprint center at pavement datum

sourceFacts.facadeBehavior: Curtain wall undulates on alternating floors; full-height external glass fins.

reconstruction.sectionMeaning: height, half-length, half-width; footprint-scaled photographic reconstruction
reconstruction.roofEquipment: Schematic plant, supports and helipad inside the crown
reconstruction.basis: SOM exterior/base/corner photos and Meinhardt facade brochure pages 10–11. Taper dimensions, bay counts, intermediate heights, crown braces, entrance widths and roof equipment are inferred, not surveyed.

limitations: Original chinaWorldTowerStudy.encodeAssembly remains byte-reconstitutable: 40771324 bytes, sha256:692047904356122c40524acc84d8d1b53e10088e1f63b426816b4fa7e6703ee3, 938584 expanded /485508 stored triangles, five mesh parts/seven placements, seven groups/four shared graphs and no embedded images. The new flattened browser source and four authored levels preserve taper, recessed chamfer returns, alternating-floor curtain wall, 600 mm glass fins at street/close, two service belts, full-height lobby diamonds, four-sided tall crown with open corner/top gaps, schematic roof plant/helipad and east hotel/west office canopies with four illustrative revolving drums. Close retains narrow flat metal fin leading edges and finer curtain rhythm instead of hundreds of thousands of solid facade prisms; street coarsens fin/diamond spacing; district groups floor rows and uses opaque crown screens; skyline keeps silhouette/service color bands, coarse diamonds and open framed crown in one opaque draw. Three canonical shared graphs (stainless metal, concrete and granite) plus opaque glazing, 52-percent clear glazing and recess palette yield six near groups with no bitmap copies. Published 74/80/81 floor labels describe different schedules and remain distinct; 70 equal tower intervals are a working facade division, not a surveyed floor schedule. Intermediate taper dimensions, alternating-depth amplitudes, service levels 122.6/134.9 and 238.8/251.3 m, 294 m crown base, braces, fine bay counts, canopy heights and dimensions, drums, generic lobby fitout, rooftop equipment and 327 m helipad datum are inferred. Helipad existence follows SOM opening report; precise platform datum and roof equipment layout are unaudited. Glass frit, LED strips, fountain courts, annexes, interiors and structural bolts are not modeled. Actual phone/laptop dense-city measurements remain pending.

geographic.reviewStatus: signed medium-fi mapped tower with architect cardinal entrance control
geographic.orientationConfidence: exact-QID outline and architect east hotel/west office control; precise entry offsets approximate
geographic.notes: Fresh exact Q2006129 way 116944490 independently confirms the individual 330 m/74-level China World Tower A rectangular footprint, unchanged from the cached 58.465 by 52.803 m ring within 0.002 m rounding. Retain anchor [116.45236545,39.91097545] and heading -1.568897708342: native +X north bearing 359.89 degrees, -Z east bearing 89.89 degrees for the hotel, and +Z west bearing 269.89 degrees for offices. SOM explicitly documents office entrance west and hotel entrance east, supplying the signed cardinal control that the rectangle alone lacks. Primary architect whole/base/fin/canopy photographs and facade-consultant pages 10/11 were actually inspected. Authored body half dimensions 28.65/25.8 m sit about 0.6 m inside the exact mapped rectangle; chamfers/recesses simplify its ring and projecting diamond fins/canopies intentionally extend beyond it. Entrance sides are documented but centered offsets, vestibule positions, widths and canopy extents are illustrative photo reconstructions, not surveyed. Separate ballroom/retail annexes, mall, road skywalk, fountains, Tower B and actual terrain/plaza grade remain outside this individual tower. Flat geographic capture certifies relative footprint and facing only.
